lines.en: I call up Chinami to find that Chika just left for work a few minutes ago and that she is now lonely and needs someone tall enough to retrieve the box of cereal on top of her fridge.
lines.zh: 我打电话给 Chinami，结果发现 Chika 几分钟前刚去上班，她现在一个人很孤单，需要有个够高的人帮她把冰箱顶上那盒麦片拿下来。

lines.en: I can’t say I called her with any intention of showing up to perform tasks that she is unable to but, then again, I don’t really have any idea what my intentions were in the first place.
lines.zh: 我不能说自己打这通电话时就打算上门去干她干不了的活，不过话说回来，我一开始也真不知道自己到底想干什么。

lines.en: Knowing full well how strange and socially unacceptable this is, I head over to Chika’s apartment without her knowledge and then proceed to feed her sister sugary food before letting her out on the balcony.
lines.zh: 我完全清楚这有多奇怪、多不合常理，但还是瞒着 Chika 去了她的公寓，然后给她妹妹喂了含糖的食物，再放她到阳台上去。

lines.en: It’s still cool this early in the morning, and Chinami wastes no time exclaiming about how pretty the sky looks and how much nicer it is without all of the glass in the way.
lines.zh: 大清早天还凉，Chinami 一刻没耽误地感叹天空有多好看，没有玻璃挡着有多好。

lines.en: It is at that moment that I remember she is not supposed to be out here without supervision, and I can say with absolute certainty that anyone I watch is assuredly not being “supervised.”
lines.zh: 就在那一刻我想起来，她是不该在没人看着的时候到外面来的；而我可以绝对肯定地说，被我看着的人绝对算不上「有人看着」。

lines.en: As such, I force Chinami back inside and cheer her up with another bowl of cereal before finally deciding that I should tell Chika about this.
lines.zh: 于是我把 Chinami 赶回屋里，又用一碗麦片把她哄高兴，最后决定还是该把这事告诉 Chika。

lines.en: Not because I feel weird about hanging out with her little sister, though. Because I feel bad that there is now no cereal left and Chika is extremely poor.
lines.zh: 不过不是因为跟她妹妹混在一起让我觉得别扭。是因为现在麦片一点不剩，而 Chika 穷得要命，我觉得过意不去。

lines.en: But if cereal and the exploitation of poverty is what it takes to make Chinami happy and keep her from falling to her death, so be it.
lines.zh: 但如果麦片和剥削穷人能让 Chinami 开心、不让她摔死，那就这样吧。

lines.en: I can always replace cereal, but I can not replace her.
lines.zh: 麦片我随时能再买，她我换不来。
Chinami 的好感度提升到了 [chinami_love]！
